benchmark.name: EngDesign-Open

summary.en: EngDesign-Open evaluates practical engineering design across 67 open tasks using simulation-backed, rubric-based grading.
summary.zh: EngDesign-Open 使用基于 simulation 和 rubric 的评分，评估模型完成 67 个开放 engineering design task 的能力。

task_format.en: The model proposes structured engineering designs across nine domains; executable domain-specific simulations and rubrics assess the resulting artifacts.
task_format.zh: 模型需要在九个 engineering domain 中提出结构化设计，随后由 domain-specific simulation 和 rubric 评估生成的 artifact。

explanation.en: Average Score is the numerical score averaged over the fixed EngDesign-Open tasks. The paper's iterative Average Pass Rate is a separate protocol and is not merged.
explanation.zh: Average Score 是固定 EngDesign-Open task 上的数值分数平均值。论文中的 iterative Average Pass Rate 属于独立 protocol，不会合并。

observations.evaluation_protocol: EngDesign-Open fixed 67-task subset; each task is evaluated over three independent trials and headline Average Score is kept separate from iterative-design Average Pass Rate.
observations.date_notes: A score-publication date is not present in the source export.
observations.eligibility_reason: Capability eligibility uses the dated curated observation and canonical protocol; reported-result eligibility requires result_public_date.
observations.notes: Operational evaluation timeline only; not a historical public-result date.

benchmark.date_policy: Primary lifecycle time uses the earliest available date among evaluation/run time, model release time, and the earliest recorded score-publication time for the same observation. Plot dates and T50/T80/T90 are clipped at benchmark release, so lifecycle durations are never negative; original dates remain preserved for provenance.

test-of-time.rule: T50 >= 12 months OR T90 >= 24 months, including censoring

still-frontier.rule: right-censored T50 AND normalized progress < 50% AND coverage not low

recently-saturated.rule: T90 crossing within 3 months of snapshot
